blockers.detail: Domain/axis change and numeric-value invariance can hold simultaneously. The original contrast and falsifier do not make the two stated models observationally exclusive. Specify which semantic object is claimed invariant and a consequence on which the two full models differ.

The five cited renderings and their X classes inherit working interpretations. GDT877 supplies raw construction fidelity only. The inspected packet does not independently bind a value or measurement/grade domain; this is not a claim that no such evidence can exist elsewhere.

claim_ceiling: Original semantic hypothesis remains untested, not refuted. GDT877 qualifies source units only. No canonical SEM card or historical source bytes are changed.

design.contrast: The same written value slot changes between grade, measured material, nominal field and result/stage when X changes
design.countermodel: A fixed ordinal value model predicts invariant value interpretation and treats X as ordinary lexical content
design.falsifier: Hold exact X-daiin triples with independently coded X classes; if the value remains invariant across classes, stop this hypothesis
design.prediction: The same written value slot changes between grade, measured material, nominal field and result/stage when X changes
design.principal_risk: The cited report supplies structural or working observations, not independently bound Voynich meaning; required semantic endpoints may be unavailable.
design.related: Near GDT764/GDT686 and existing quantity/calibration routes; targets head-conditioned axis selection rather than free component meaning.
design.smallest_next_step: Check exact current semantic counterparts and freeze the endpoint coding before any new extraction.

reason: The proposed head-conditioned axis and fixed ordinal plus lexical X are compatible without extra commitments: the same numerical value can apply to different measure or grade domains. The source itself keeps III in all five renderings. Finding a different X class or a stable value therefore does not distinguish these models. all_of.detail: Declare incompatible observable predictions of the complete models, explicitly separating a value from its domain/unit and allowing a fixed value to combine with lexical heads. A purely structural contrast may be tested without assigning a number; it must be reported as such.

For semantic adjudication, justify the relevant value/domain endpoint independently of the inherited German renderings and reserve adequate untouched comparison material. Use the executable relation gates when an ordered inscription evidence packet is proposed. The existing four raw anchors are a source precondition, not this semantic endpoint.
